Re-delivered rows also duplicate txn_ids (5128 rows vs 4802 distinct), so the fix must parse epoch-millis timestamps and keep one row per txn_id.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(r.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, r.customer_id, CAST(r.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(r.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, r.ts AS txn_ts, CAST(r.ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN txn_ts LIKE '%-%' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') r QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.txn_id ORDER BY r.ingest_ts, r.batch_id) = 1;"}}
